title: Audio wiring integrated solder photo provenance
notes: The six listed production PNGs are complete opened connector photos; their content rectangles cover the whole image.
For five assets, rawSource.path is the exact built-in ImageGen output path and rawSource.prompt is the adopted prompt recorded in generation-prompt-history.json.
The RCA source was an existing local photo and was rebuilt without ImageGen. Its archived source is the baseline copy recorded above.
Contact coordinates are illustrative visual anchors, not mechanical dimensions or tolerances.
The separate XLR female overview image remains available to endpoint selection cards; it is not a second photo in the wiring Canvas.

The ImageGen history records the exact generated output paths and adopted prompts, but does not record the local file path passed in as the reference-image input; the original reference URLs are listed per asset.
